verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a real-time communications SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented feature for exporting all account data in open formats. Recording, raw audio-frame access and usage-fetching REST APIs are adjacent developer building blocks, not a user-facing export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
